title: 第八章 感情
content_zh:
艾妮尔的话一出口，整个酒馆都安静了下来，静静的听着他们吞咽口水的声音，艾妮尔慢慢的转身，“他在哪里？”

    “他……他……”服务生犹豫着，不知道要不要说，推了推靠在柜台上的那个贵族，“胡子，要不要说啊？”

    “当然说了，哈哈哈~”刚才还一本正经的胡子大叔，突然哈哈的大笑了起来，“没想到首领他竟然有了这个打算，真是的，他怎么不早说，不然我早就给他找一个了，男人啊！还是需要女人的。”

    “哈哈哈~胡子说的对，首领也是男人啊！哈哈哈~”笑声一阵盖过一阵。

    听着这样的笑声，艾妮尔的眉头慢慢的皱起，最后紧紧的锁了起来，可是她强压着心中的不快，“他在哪里？”

    “他出去了，安排好你们的事后他就出去了。”胡子回答着邪邪的笑了起来，“怎么？这么快就开始想他了？对了，应该怎么说呢？其实是求了婚的，应该就是未婚夫吧？”

    “是啊！未婚夫！未婚夫！”酒馆里的其它贵族不断的起哄。

    “出去？”艾妮尔对他们的嬉笑充耳不闻，望了一眼紧闭的窗户和大门，“现在是白天！”

    “是啊！不过我们的首领强大到不怕阳光！”胡子得意的炫耀着，转身向着服务生，“再给我来一杯！”

    “还一杯？胡子，你上个月的帐还没结清呢！”虽然服务生嘴上这么说，不过还是给胡子又倒了杯爱沦特，省着点喝！

    “放心！过几天我就有任务了，到时一定把明年的酒钱一起付了。”胡子端起来，一口喝了半杯，完全没把对方的提醒放在心上。

    看着这些跟佣兵一样的贵族们，艾妮尔只是摇了摇头，转身向刚才的来路走去。

    “等等！你去哪里？”胡子喊道。

    “回去睡觉！”艾妮尔没有回头。

    “睡觉？”胡子一愣。

    “我是吸血鬼，白天睡觉不是很正常么？”艾妮尔穿过小门时，最后留下这么一句。

    “可是……”胡子呆呆的看着她的离去，“我们这里好象没有这种规定。”

    “所以说你们已经不是真正的吸血鬼了。”艾妮尔早就没了身影，不过她的回答却如此清晰可见，回味着这话的意思，胡子愣愣的走到萨尔他们一桌，坐了下来。

    爱夏有些好笑的拍了拍胡子的肩膀，“怎么？被教训了？”

    “不……不是，只是有点……”胡子说不出来，不知道为什么，那句话一直堵在心里，有点难受，却又不讨厌。

    “算了，她很特别。”爱夏笑了笑，带着一点点惆怅，还有一点点说不清楚的味道。

    艾妮尔听着他们的对话，苦笑了下，继续向前走去，这些贵族不算太强，数量也不多，奥利维斯说过的几万在哪里？他们又有多强。

    一边思考着，艾妮尔一边往回走，穿过一个个的房间，目光略微的扫了一下，每个房间都差不多，跟军人一样的统一，只是不够整洁。
content_en:
As soon as Anel's words came out, the entire tavern fell silent. Listening to the sound of them swallowing, Anel slowly turned around and asked, "Where is he?"

    "He...he..." The waiter hesitated, not knowing whether to say it or not, and pushed the nobleman who was leaning on the counter, "Whisker, do you want to say it?"

    "Of course I said it, hahaha~" The bearded uncle who was serious just now suddenly laughed out loud, "I didn't expect the leader to have such a plan. Really, why didn't he tell me earlier? Otherwise, I would have found him a man. Man! He still needs women."

    "Hahaha~ Huzi is right, the leader is also a man! Hahaha~" The laughter covered him up one after another.

    Listening to such laughter, Enel's brows slowly wrinkled, and finally she frowned tightly, but she suppressed the unhappiness in her heart and asked, "Where is he?"

    "He went out. He went out after arranging your affairs." Huzi replied and smiled evilly, "What? You started to miss him so soon? By the way, what should I say? In fact, he proposed to me, so he should be his fiancé, right?"

    "Yes! Fiancé! Fiancé!" The other nobles in the tavern kept making noises.

    "Go out?" Enel turned a deaf ear to their laughter and glanced at the closed windows and doors, "It's daytime now!"

    "Yes! But our leader is so strong that he is not afraid of the sun!" Beard proudly showed off, turning to the waiter, "Give me another drink!"

    "One more glass? Huzi, you haven't settled last month's bill yet!" Although the waiter said so, he still poured Huzi another cup of Airente to save some drinks!

    "Don't worry! I'll have a mission in a few days, and I'll definitely pay for next year's wine together." Huzi picked it up and drank half the glass in one gulp, completely ignoring the other person's reminder.

    Looking at these nobles who were like mercenaries, Enel just shook her head, turned around and walked towards the way she came from.

    "Wait! Where are you going?" Huzi shouted.

    "Go back to sleep!" Enel did not look back.

    "Sleeping?" Huzi was stunned.

    "I'm a vampire, isn't it normal to sleep during the day?" Enel left this last sentence when she passed through the small door.

    "But..." Huzi watched her leave blankly, "We don't seem to have such a rule here."

    "So you are no longer real vampires." Enel has long since disappeared, but her answer is so clear. After thinking about the meaning of these words, Beard walked to Sal and his team's table in a daze and sat down.

    Ai Xia patted Hu Hu's shoulder in a funny way, "What? Have you been taught a lesson?"

    "No...no, it's just a bit..." Huzi couldn't say it. I don't know why, but that sentence kept stuck in his heart. It was a bit uncomfortable, but not annoying.

    "Forget it, she is very special." Ai Xia smiled, with a little melancholy and a little unclear taste.

    Enel listened to their conversation, smiled bitterly, and continued to move forward. These nobles were not too strong, and their number was not large. Where were the tens of thousands that Olivia said? How strong are they?

    While thinking about it, Anel walked back, passing through each room, and glanced slightly. Every room was similar, as unified as a soldier, but not neat enough.
